title: FeatureArtifact content (P2.3)
description: Content-addressed payload of a FeatureArtifact (RFC-0007). One artifact per frame: keypoints + descriptors for a single image. M0 uses a JSON array representation; a packed/binary encoding is reserved for the COLMAP adapter and will declare a future schema_version. additionalProperties is implicit-true: additive-only under the RFC-0005 Schema Evolution Policy. The producer guarantees count == keypoints.length == descriptors.length.

detector.description: Canonical detector id, e.g. mock (M0); SIFT names are ratified with the COLMAP adapter.

descriptor_type.description: Canonical descriptor type, e.g. mock_16 (16-dim float rows).

count.description: Number of keypoints; equal to keypoints.length and descriptors.length.
